# Norna

> Norna is an opinionated open source CLI for building responsive websites from Markdown, images, and a theme preset.

The authoritative documentation is maintained as Markdown in the Norna GitHub
repository. Norna is pre-1.0, requires Node.js 22.12 or later, and currently
integrates publishing with GitHub Pages only. Rendered HTML links are used below
only for the guided introduction and visual examples.

## Guided Introduction

- [Install Norna](https://janga.github.io/norna/getting-started/install-norna/)
- [Choose A Theme](https://janga.github.io/norna/getting-started/choose-a-theme/)
- [Grow Your Site](https://janga.github.io/norna/getting-started/grow-your-site/)
- [Prepare Your Site](https://janga.github.io/norna/getting-started/prepare-your-site/)
- [Build And Publish](https://janga.github.io/norna/getting-started/build-and-publish/)
